addShow.label: stop — the other order that can fill

edits.reason: Say teaches the stop as the second of two pending orders: 'place a limit sell there along with your stop. Then you simply walk away and let one of them fill.' The take-profit ('target') is labelled but the stop, its teaching counterpart, is unlabelled. 'stop' is a valid (L) anchor for trade_setup_long, so a level kind matches; the move draws the bare stop line but does not label it, so this label is non-redundant and closes the gap.

notes: Beat 'set-and-forget' (trade_setup_long): the existing target level + 'order fills' marker are correct and say-justified ('a take-profit level... a resistance you expect to hold'). The one add is the stop label, the explicit counterpart in 'let one of them fill'. Beat 'trailing' (uptrend) is already complete: markers at hl1/hl2 capture 'move your stop up... as it makes each new higher low' and hh2 captures 'ride the trend... as long as the trend holds'; the move already draws the HH/HL structure and flipLevel, so no further anchors are warranted. CONCEPT beats (intro, partials, recap) draw no chart and were skipped. No noAnchorGaps.
